verdict.rationale: GitLab's merge request workflow is core to the product (evidence references security findings appearing in merge requests, AI agents converting issues into merge requests, and Git workflow docs), confirming the feature exists and is deeply integrated. However, the evidence pack lacks direct first-party documentation of the MR creation/discussion/approval/merge workflow itself, and community evidence focuses on performance/reliability issues rather than confirming the MR workflow's quality directly. missing for 10: dedicated documentation of merge request creation, review/discussion threads, approval rules, and merge process; independent hands-on validation of the MR workflow specifically.
